citation.locator: Correction notice, complete body; incorporates the unchanged dividend amounts from the August 9 release while correcting record and payment dates
citation.verbatim: The press release issued August 9, 2024 was changed only to correct the record date and payment date for the dividends on its outstanding common stock. The dividend amounts have not changed. The dividends will be payable on August 30, 2024 to all stockholders of record as of the close of business on August 23, 2024, not payable on August 20, 2024 to all stockholders of record on August 12, 2024 as previously disclosed.

D1.decision: Process the mandatory dividend using the corrected August 23 record date and August 30 pay date. Confirm 40,000 eligible shares and book the $6,800 gross receivable. Hold only the withholding adjustment and net-cash determination pending foreign beneficial-owner withholding-tax/treaty documentation; no election is available or required.
